text:
deploy-bot: [AUTO] RC rc-4587 artifact flagged: SBOM provenance mismatch on package layer. Blocking canary until triage. scan-id=sbom-20240315-rc4587

mike: pinging to see scope — is this transitive or direct dependency?

sara: looks transitive from the node-builder image. small lib bump: fastparse 0.9.2 -> 0.9.3. no CVEs reported in scan but provenance signatures differ.

jamie: a couple options: pin the base image digest (quick), or rollback the rc if we can't get signature evidence. prefer pin+note in release notes if security approves.

mike: agree. can we get cosign attestation or signature proof quickly? any way to re-run signing?

sara: trying `cosign verify-blob --signature sig.blob registry.redwood/release/rc-4587` now. if it fails we need origin evidence from infra.

deploy-bot: evidence requested: upload provenance/attestation and /or origin URL. deadline for canary: 30m from thread_ts.

legal-bot: @sara @mike we need a short release note line calling out pinned provenance if you go that route, and a linked audit trail. Also need approval from Compliance for any temporary pin.

jamie: if cosign verifies, we can proceed with a note: `Pinned base image digest due to provenance mismatch; full sign-off pending.` that keeps canary moving.

sara: cosign returned partial: signature key id mismatch for one layer, others OK. uploading `/artifacts/rc-4587/prov.json` and `/logs/cosign-1741112223.log`. attaching in thread.

mike: thanks. tagging @legal-bot for approval path, and @deploy-bot please add a `release-note: SBOM-provenance-pinned` tag to the RC metadata if we pin.

legal-bot: Received. Compliance requires one of: (a) independent attestation from builder CI, (b) signed provenance attached, or (c) 72-hr timeboxed pin with escalation plan. Which option are we choosing?

jamie: propose (c) now — 72-hr pin, escalate to Security in 24 hrs if no signed attestation. We have low CVSS in scan.

mike: +1. I'll create a short rollback checkpoint: if new signature not provided in 24h, revert to previous good RC. Marking action items.

sara: updated RC metadata: `pinned_base_digest=sha256:9f8a...`, `pin_expiry=72h`, `pin_escalate=24h`. Adding release note draft: "Temporarily pinned base image due to SBOM provenance mismatch; awaiting final attestation."

deploy-bot: action recorded: pin applied, canary allowed with `pin_expiry=72h`. Notifying all production watchers.

legal-bot: Approved temporary pin under exception policy EMP-2. Please add audit ticket ID: AUD-3217 to the release notes before cut.

jamie: will add AUD-3217 to the release-note and to the ticket. also adding `rollback_condition: signature_missing_after_24h` to the release metadata so deploy-bot can auto-quarantine.

mike: good. small ask: can we note the affected package in release notes for product teams? `fastparse@0.9.3 (transitive)`

sara: done. release note final line: "Pinned base image digest due to SBOM provenance mismatch affecting transitive dependency fastparse@0.9.3. Temporary pin (72h) under AUD-3217; will rollback if attestation unavailable after 24h."

deploy-bot: canary resumed. monitoring traces and vulnerability regen. :eyes: 

mike: thanks team. I'll follow up in 12h and escalate to Security if no attestation by then.

jamie: adding checklist item to release: `attach cosign proof OR revert`.

sara: copying relevant logs to compliance bucket s3://redwood-compliance/audits/AUD-3217/rc-4587/

legal-bot: closing loop for now. keep this thread for updates. :white_check_mark:
